name: parse_swahili_verb
description: Call first for every Swahili verb. Returns candidate parses (neg, sm, tam, rel, om, root, exts, final) and the tense_key + negative flag to pass to generate_verb. Pick the parse that fits the sentence. status: ok = from active rules/entries and attested; unattested = produced but weakly attested or from a tentative rule; unknown = no rule or entry; flag = do not guess, ask a speaker.

name: lookup_word
description: Kidaw'ida translations of a Swahili word or lemma, ranked (speaker_verified > corpus_attested > mined_alignment > agent_interpretation), with noun class, plural, senses and corpus (dav_swa vs bible). Choose the sense; Bible-only words may be archaic. status: ok = from active rules/entries and attested; unattested = produced but weakly attested or from a tentative rule; unknown = no rule or entry; flag = do not guess, ask a speaker.

name: noun_info
description: Class, plural, number-invariance, animacy and conflicting readings of a Kidaw'ida noun. Call for every subject/object noun before generating agreement. Pass sw_noun to check the animacy-override list. status: ok = from active rules/entries and attested; unattested = produced but weakly attested or from a tentative rule; unknown = no rule or entry; flag = do not guess, ask a speaker.

name: concord
description: Agreement form for a class or person and slot: SM (bare), SM_a, SM_e, OM, REL, ADJ, DEM_near, DEM_mid, DEM_far, POSS (all persons), ASSOC ('of'), OSE ('all'), SELF. status: ok = from active rules/entries and attested; unattested = produced but weakly attested or from a tentative rule; unknown = no rule or entry; flag = do not guess, ask a speaker.

cls.description: Kidaw'ida class label (u, wi, ghu, i, i_nasal, ji, ghi, chi, va, ri, lu, ku), Bantu number (1-15), or person (1sg, 2sg, 3sg, 1pl, 2pl)

name: generate_verb
description: Builds the Kidaw'ida verb from features; never write verb morphology yourself. dav_root from lookup_word (root without final vowel), subj = the controlling noun's class (noun_info) or person, tense = tense_key from parse_swahili_verb. Set subj_coordinated for coordinated subjects (returns flag). status: ok = from active rules/entries and attested; unattested = produced but weakly attested or from a tentative rule; unknown = no rule or entry; flag = do not guess, ask a speaker.

subj.description: Kidaw'ida class label (u, wi, ghu, i, i_nasal, ji, ghi, chi, va, ri, lu, ku), Bantu number (1-15), or person (1sg, 2sg, 3sg, 1pl, 2pl)

obj.description: Kidaw'ida class label (u, wi, ghu, i, i_nasal, ji, ghi, chi, va, ri, lu, ku), Bantu number (1-15), or person (1sg, 2sg, 3sg, 1pl, 2pl), or refl

name: generate_modifier
description: Agreeing modifier for a noun: kind adj (nominal stem, e.g. baa), adj_stative (SM + stem, e.g. zamie), dem_near/dem_mid/dem_far, poss (dav_stem = 1sg..3pl), num (e.g. ingi, mweri), ose, self, assoc. status: ok = from active rules/entries and attested; unattested = produced but weakly attested or from a tentative rule; unknown = no rule or entry; flag = do not guess, ask a speaker.

cls.description: Kidaw'ida class label (u, wi, ghu, i, i_nasal, ji, ghi, chi, va, ri, lu, ku), Bantu number (1-15), or person (1sg, 2sg, 3sg, 1pl, 2pl)

name: retrieve_examples
description: k similar Swahili-Kidaw'ida training pairs for a Swahili sentence. Use to check word choice and idioms, not to copy whole sentences. status: ok = from active rules/entries and attested; unattested = produced but weakly attested or from a tentative rule; unknown = no rule or entry; flag = do not guess, ask a speaker.

name: check_translation
description: After drafting: per Swahili verb, finds the Kidaw'ida verb and checks negation, tense, SM series, subject class and extensions against the rule book. Fix verbs with status flag (see mismatches). status: ok = from active rules/entries and attested; unattested = produced but weakly attested or from a tentative rule; unknown = no rule or entry; flag = do not guess, ask a speaker.
